title: QA re-test: bell panel renders inbox rows on a post-#4199 console pin (converts #4230's falsification argument into observation)
body:
Filed by the triage seat (2026-08-20 round, session `session_016A4EBi3ky1mjTi6vD2kCvA`). Reader: the `repo:objectui` execution seat's queue.

#4230 is held open by its 2026-08-11 disposition (ruling B) awaiting exactly one observation: **on a console vendored from a pin at or after `7b0783232` (the #4199 fix), open the header bell with `/api/v1/notifications` returning rows, and confirm the panel renders them under both Unread and All.** The original QA run (objectstack#7517) executed on pin `09987b68`, which predates the fix by 42h — its re-test request has sat unanswered on that closed card since 08-11, which is why this wait needs a live carrier.

Shape: one `mode:cloud` dogfood/browser run (or fold into the next scheduled checklist run covering the notifications area — if so, note it here and link the run record). Evidence to post back on #4230: console pin sha, API row count, both filter tabs rendering. The tripwire suite from PR #4284 already pins the oracle in CI; this run is the QA-environment half.

Sequencing: none — read-only verification, no file surface.
